entries.zh: 喇叭类吹奏乐器（词头首词 cabuche 不可解，仅知与 trompeta「喇叭」同类）
entries.en: trumpet (the first element "cabuche" of the headword remains unexplained)
entries.notes: L 首词 cabuche 非常规西语词形且汉字两字均有异文疑（惣/愬、篡/簪），仅 trompeta（喇叭）一义可定。

entries.en: to take out; to take, pick up
to levy apportioned charges on the community; a communal levy
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节 pay（疑即「派」）在汉字栏无对应字。

entries.en: to exert force; to strain
entries.notes: M 栏音写五音节（lou chin lat gio ne）与汉字单字不对应，仅首音节 lou＝努可解。

entries.en: to exhaust one's strength; to spend all one's force
to apply, exert one's strength
to put forth effort; to exert force
to draw, scoop water with a ladle (cazo)
entries.notes: M 栏音节多于汉字、仅 ta＝搭可解，末尾 dila binaja 疑涉水器（参同页第 11 条 binaja）。

entries.en: to simmer, stew; to endure
entries.notes: L 栏尾部「para-」不完整，汉字栏有异文疑（熬/煞）。

entries.zh: 抽出、从众物中抽出一物
entries.en: to draw out one thing from among others; to withdraw

entries.zh: 汲水（自河中或水缸、水器中取水）
entries.en: to draw water (from the river or from a jar, vessel)
entries.notes: L 栏尾部残缺（「o la car bim-」），主义据汉字「汲」与音写 guip chui（汲水）可定。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: L 栏残缺且汉字形存疑（捯/搊）、M 栏单音节 hou 无法对证，材料不足。

entries.en: to shake, agitate water
to draw, pull one thing out from among others
to simmer, boil scented water (agua de olor)
entries.notes: L 栏尾部残缺（「por algu-」），「熬香水」一义据汉字与音写 go hio chui 可定。

entries.zh: 熬茉莉花水（煮花取香水；原稿花名字形存疑，音写 bag ly hua 近「茉莉花」）
entries.en: to boil jasmine-flower water (scented water; the flower name's first character is uncertain in the manuscript)
entries.notes: 汉字首字存疑（目/白），据音写 bag-ly-hua 推断为茉莉花，属推断而非定论。

entries.zh: 把掉进水里的东西捞起来
entries.en: to fish up, pull out what has fallen into the water
to tread a waterwheel; a foot-powered water-lifting wheel
entries.notes: L 栏尾部「comarra no」无法解读，释义以汉字「踏車」与音写 ta chia 为准。

entries.en: to levy communal money to pay on behalf of another

entries.zh: 逐一清点；把账目誊清开列
entries.en: to enumerate, recount one by one; to draw up the accounts in fair copy
